description:
Everyone is talking about AI and Machine Learning jobs in 2026, but almost no one explains what you actually need to learn to become an AI/ML Architect – the person who designs the entire AI system end‑to‑end, from data pipelines to model deployment in production.

In this video, I break down the exact skills you need in 2026 if you want to move beyond “just training models” and start architecting AI systems that are reliable, scalable, and actually used by real customers.

You’ll learn why mastering Kubeflow, MLflow, and Weights & Biases is non‑negotiable if you want to run training, tracking, and deployment pipelines at scale without things breaking every week. We’ll talk about fine‑tuning foundation models, building robust RAG pipelines, and doing prompt engineering at a systems level, not as random prompt hacks.

We’ll also dive into cloud depth: choosing one platform (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Vertex AI) and going truly deep instead of staying at “hello world” tutorials.
title: Must Know skills as an AI/ML Architect | AI/ML Architect Skills 2026 #simplilearn #shorts

You should also understand basic technology concepts like APIs and simple programming knowledge such as Python. This helps designers collaborate better with developers.
